card: Adds unit tests covering truncated CompactSize prefixes and malformed transaction encodings, including invalid witness flags (0x02), witness elements extending past the end of data, and truncated script or locktime fields. It also verifies that DecodeHexTx rejects these payloads without falling back to parsing them as non-witness transactions. The author identified these test gaps while analyzing the bitcoin-s implementation. This is a low-risk, test-only change with no external dependencies.
evidence: Author note in description: 'These were discovered by finding gaps in an alternate implementation (bitcoin-s)'
problem: Unit test suites lack explicit test cases for truncated CompactSize prefixes and several malformed transaction wire encodings, leaving subtle deserialization behavior and DecodeHexTx fallback rules unasserted.

risk.why: Touches only unit tests; any error would cause test suite failures during build/CI rather than affecting runtime behavior.

summary: Adds unit tests covering truncated CompactSize prefixes and several malformed transaction serializations. The tests verify that deserialization throws an exception and that DecodeHexTx does not fall back to parsing malformed witness payloads as non-witness transactions when given an unknown witness flag (0x02), oversized witness elements, truncated locktimes, or truncated output scripts.
